description: One day button of the mobile week strip. TmSchedulerDateStrip renders one per day and moves DOM focus onto the roving stop through FocusAsync.

parameters.name: Selected
parameters.description: The selected day. The matching button is aria-pressed.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today. The matching button gets aria-current=date.

parameters.name: IsStop
parameters.description: Whether this button is the roving tab stop.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: Fires with the day when the button is activated.
